title: Cabin Air Distribution Risers — Cleaning

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Cleaning of the cabin air riser ducts and their outlets, with the separate dry method that must be used on aircraft where an acoustic absorber insert is fitted inside the riser.

sections.purpose: This task gives the cleaning of the eight cabin air riser ducts and their ceiling outlets, and identifies the method to be used according to whether an acoustic absorber insert is installed.
sections.job_setup_note: The ceiling panels must be dropped along the centre section to reach the risers. The cleaning method depends on the riser standard: a riser with an absorber insert must be cleaned dry, because steam or wet cleaning saturates the bulk absorber and it does not dry out in service. Establish the fitted standard from the aircraft technical record before any cleaning agent is selected.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE AIR CONDITIONING PACKS ARE SELECTED OFF AND TAGGED BEFORE ANY DUCT IS OPENED. 2. Drop the ceiling panels along the centre section to open the ceiling void. 3. Establish whether an acoustic absorber insert is fitted in the risers and record the standard. 4. CAUTION: DO NOT USE STEAM OR A WET CLEANING AGENT IN A RISER THAT CONTAINS AN ABSORBER INSERT. THE BULK ABSORBER DOES NOT DRY OUT IN SERVICE. 5. Disconnect the riser at the accumulator D2120111712496 and release the clamp BRD511776-85. 6. On a riser without an insert, wash the duct interior with the approved agent and dry it with filtered air. 7. On a riser with an insert, clean the duct with the soft brush and the vacuum extraction unit only. 8. Clean the outlet grille and examine the grommet AES557672-7B and the spacer AES561134-8B for damage. 9. Reconnect the riser and re-clamp it at the pitch given in the task. 10. Repeat for each of the eight risers. 11. Do the cabin air distribution flow check at each outlet and confirm the flow is inside tolerance.
sections.close_out: Install the ceiling panels and make sure that no cleaning material is left in the ceiling void. Select the air conditioning packs on and confirm normal cabin airflow. Record the cleaning method used, the riser standard and the measured outlet flows in the aircraft technical record.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The dry cleaning method is mandatory on aircraft with acoustic absorber inserts fitted in the risers.

safety_precautions: Select the air conditioning packs off and tag the selector.
Use eye protection when filtered air is used to dry a duct.
Do not stand on a ceiling former.

tooling.description: Vacuum extraction unit with soft brush head
